# Upstream fixtures

These are test dependencies, not production replacements for deployed CoW infrastructure.

- `HooksTrampoline.sol`: cowprotocol/hooks-trampoline, commit `102b876e02c47bb6e821470d146ca4648f6592f9`, `src/HooksTrampoline.sol` (LGPL-3.0-only).
- `services/Signatures.sol` and `services/interfaces/*.sol`: cowprotocol/services, commit `16de4357a4bb633606bc3edfc4b3f12a67f23360`, under `contracts/solidity/` (MIT).

Sources are retained with upstream behavior; repository formatting may differ.
